answer: Anchor each identity to one licensed lagoon fishing permit, tied to a single boat moored beside the walnut grove on the lagoon's north shore. Every epoch the fisher signs a fresh catch log, species, weight and GPS track, bound to the epoch nonce and cross-checked against tide tables and gale warnings, so a copied log fails and burns the bond. A Sybil farm wanting 100 votes must crew 100 real boats, pay 100 license fees and actually fish 100 lagoons through every gale, while an honest fisher just logs one honest catch per epoch.
